Historical tool names changed from dotted to underscore notation. The selected task-listing inputs, results and implementation are otherwise unchanged.
Public repository: https://github.com/dongdongbh/Mindwtr
Old commit: 943b8a32f2b54b02cbddfb56c4054438362bb5ed
New commit: 20742629b960c322ba4035af9cc53b87fca0db8a
Evidence: https://github.com/dongdongbh/Mindwtr/blob/20742629b960c322ba4035af9cc53b87fca0db8a/apps/mcp-server/README.md
Only the selected documented operation is a target; no gate or sealed observations are provided.

newContracts.description: List tasks from the local Mindwtr SQLite database. Supports filtering by status, project, date range, and search. Supports sorting by various fields.
newContracts.name: mindwtr_list_tasks
